interactive-demo.label: Interactive Demo
interactive-demo.description: Interactive objects with click, hover, color change and animation. Demonstrates the event system and Interactive component.

hover-showcase.label: Hover Showcase
hover-showcase.description: 5 different hover effects: float, spin, grow, color change and pulse. Each object uses a different CSS cursor (pointer, grab, zoom-in, crosshair, cell).

click-playground.label: Click Playground
click-playground.description: Click counter, toggle on/off, press effect (pointerdown/up), color cycling and explode/regroup. Demonstrates click, pointerdown and pointerup.

wheel-bubbling.label: Wheel & Bubbling
wheel-bubbling.description: Mouse wheel to scale objects, event bubbling parent→child with stopPropagation(), and pointer tracking with pointermove. Demonstrates wheel, bubbling and pointermove.

hello-cube.label: Hello Cube
hello-cube.description: A 3D cube with smooth quaternion rotation. Demonstrates basic scene, camera and geometry setup.

color-palette.label: Color Palette
color-palette.description: Geometric shapes with different forms, colors and speeds. Shows createBox, createSphere and color themes.

solar-system.label: Solar System
solar-system.description: Planetary system with hierarchical orbits using parent-child pivot nodes. Demonstrates nested transforms.

shape-grid.label: Shape Grid
shape-grid.description: Procedural grid with sinusoidal wave and position-based colors. Demonstrates procedural generation and massive animation.

camera-viewpoints.label: Camera Viewpoints
camera-viewpoints.description: Multiple viewpoints (orbital, front, top-down, side) over a scene with pillars and spheres. Demonstrates camera positioning and animation.

procedural-city.label: Procedural City
procedural-city.description: Algorithmically generated city with buildings, central park and landmark tower. Demonstrates procedural generation and hierarchical grouping.

svg-showcase.label: SVG Showcase
svg-showcase.description: Visual catalog of SVG capabilities: linear/radial gradients, filters (blur, drop-shadow), clip-path, mask, Bézier paths, text and stroke gradient.

svg-animations.label: SVG Animations
svg-animations.description: Declarative native SVG animations without JavaScript: pulse (opacity), rotate, scale, color cycle, bounce (translate) and combined. Uses <animate> and <animateTransform>.

svg-interactive.label: SVG Interactive
svg-interactive.description: Grid of interactive SVG shapes with click and hover events. Uses renderToSVGElement with the Interactive component for event delegation.

colour-spiral.label: Colour Spiral
colour-spiral.description: Procedurally generated colorful dot spiral. Demonstrates createSphere, fill with color palette and polar positioning.

gradient-gallery.label: Gradient Gallery
gradient-gallery.description: Bars with vertical linear gradients and circles with radial gradients. Demonstrates linear and radial fillGradient.

circle-overlay.label: Circle Overlay
circle-overlay.description: Translucent overlapping circles creating depth. Demonstrates opacity, strokeGradient and visual composition.

porto-pareto.label: Porto Pareto
porto-pareto.description: Generative cityscape using Pareto distribution for building heights. Demonstrates Gen.pareto and constraints.

gaussian-dist.label: Gaussian Distribution
gaussian-dist.description: Normal distribution (bell curve) visualization. Demonstrates Gen.gaussian and color mapping.

colourful-grids.label: Colourful Grids
colourful-grids.description: Grid with clipped patterns using clipPath and probabilistic decisions with Gen.chance.

interactive-galaxy.label: Interactive Galaxy
interactive-galaxy.description: Particle system with parallax effect following the mouse. Demonstrates trackCursor and reactivity.

svjs-generative.label: Generative Native
svjs-generative.description: Generative art using the new SvJs native wrapper.

svgLabels.nativeAnimationsFooter: Native SVG animations — no JavaScript in the render
svgLabels.interactiveSvgSubtitle: Click on the shapes — events are processed via renderToSVGElement
